# chuck-norris-jokes-api-mcp — install (generated by anymcp)

_Public API — no authentication required._

```bash
npm i @modelcontextprotocol/sdk zod
node --loader tsx server.ts
```

mcp.json (local / stdio):
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "chuck-norris-jokes-api": { "command": "node", "args": ["--loader","tsx","/path/to/server.ts"], "env": {} } } }
```

Remote / hosted (Streamable HTTP) — agent connects to a URL instead of launching a process:
```bash
MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=3000 node --loader tsx server.ts
# → POST http://<host>:3000/mcp   (stateless; public API)
```

Tools: `chuck-norris-jokes-api.retrieve_random_joke`, `chuck-norris-jokes-api.retrieve_random_joke_by_category`, `chuck-norris-jokes-api.retrieve_categories`, `chuck-norris-jokes-api.search_jokes`
